## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--tillie-boulter.md)

Tillie is a friend to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and demonstrated her support by taking Anne's side when she was punished at school. Following a humiliating punishment from Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) that drove [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to temporarily quit attending school, Tillie stood by her during the ordeal.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P71](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0071), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), +2 more_
